# Deployment profiles (C012)

| Profile | Min kernel | Min memory MiB | KVM | cgroup v2 | Nested virt allowed | Offline grace (s) | Telemetry buffer MiB |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| cloud | 5.10 | 65536 | True | True | False | 0 | 256 |
| datacenter | 5.10 | 131072 | True | True | False | 300 | 512 |
| near-edge | 5.10 | 16384 | True | True | False | 3600 | 1024 |
| far-edge | 5.10 | 8192 | True | True | False | 86400 | 2048 |

Unsupported: nested virtualization on every profile; any host without usable `/dev/kvm`, unified cgroup v2, virtualization CPU flags or time sync; far-edge sessions above 8192 MiB.
